Description: Deal 6 damage at range.
Deal 3 damage at range.
Notes: The game has almost no 0-cost cards; the curve needs a floor.

Description: Deal 5 damage.
Deal 4 damage to everything within 2 tiles of the target.
Deal 12 damage in a 3x3 area.
Gain 7 Shield.
Heal an ally for 15.
Deal 6 damage to everything within 3 tiles of the target.
Deal 3 damage to each of three different enemies.
Engine Work: Multi-target selection. Every effect today lands on one aim tile plus an area; picking N separate tiles is a different targeting model.

Description: Gain 5 Shield, 2 Block charges and 1 Parry charge.
Teleport up to 3 tiles.
Push the target 2 tiles away.
Engine Work: PushEffect - shared with the Knight cards above.

Description: Set three tiles alight. Anything standing there at end of turn takes 4 damage.
Notes: The pitch is "tiles mutate the characters standing on them" - hazards are the most on-theme thing missing.
Engine Work: Persistent tile hazards - a tile that carries an effect with no character on it. GridTile has no such concept yet.

Description: Push every adjacent enemy 2 tiles away.
Engine Work: PushEffect with an area, pushing outward from the caster rather than along one aim direction.

Description: Root everything in a 3x3 area.
Swap places with any character on the board.
Root and apply 2 Weaken in a 3x3 area.
An ally may move again this turn.
Engine Work: GrantMoveEffect - hand a free move to another character. MoveEffect always moves the source.

Description: Deal 5 damage in a cone and push everything it hits.
Notes: Half of this is buildable today - drop the push and it ships.
Engine Work: The damage half already works via the Cone3 pattern; only the push is missing.

Description: Teleport 2 tiles and gain Dodge.
Apply 3 Weaken.
Apply 3 Weaken and 3 Poison.
Root the target and apply 2 Weaken.
Deal 5 damage and Freeze the target.
Your next attack is doubled. Draw a card.
Give an ally 2 Strength.
Apply 3 Weaken to everything within 2 tiles of the target.
Gain 2 Dodge charges.
Give an ally 3 Block charges.
Apply 4 Poison to everything within 2 tiles of the target.
Deal 4 damage and set the target Burning for 3.
Notes: The Fire tag exists on CardTag with nothing behind it.
Engine Work: BurnStatus plus StatusType.Burn appended. Nearly a copy of PoisonStatus but unblockable-on-hit rather than at turn end - which is exactly why it should reuse the same shape.

Description: Negate the next card that enemy plays.
Engine Work: An OnCardPlayed gate. ActRefusal already denies actions - this is the same idea aimed at one card rather than the turn.

Description: Take another turn.
Notes: Cheap to describe, expensive to define. Park it.
Engine Work: Turn economy. There is deliberately no turn order today - clicking a character makes it active - so "another turn" needs defining first.

Description: Gain 2 energy.
Engine Work: EnergyEffect. Energy lives on Character, so the effect is small - the balance risk is not.

Description: The next card you play resolves twice.
Engine Work: Re-running a card's actions needs CardPlayManager to keep the last play around. DoubleNextAttack is the narrow version that already works.

Description: The target cannot act or be acted upon for 2 turns.
Engine Work: A stronger Frozen - ActRefusal plus a targeting refusal. TargetSelector has no concept of an untargetable character.

Description: Three tiles become impassable for 2 turns.
Notes: Build alongside Wall of Fire; one system covers both.
Engine Work: Tile blocking - same tile-state system as Wall of Fire, minus the damage.

Description: Deal 3 damage three times.
Notes: Interacts with Block in a way the game has no card for yet.
Engine Work: A repeat count on an effect entry. Matters because Block reduces each hit separately - three small hits beat one big one into Block.

Description: Draw 2 cards.
Notes: DrawEffect is used by exactly one totem right now.

Description: Lose 5 health. Draw 2 cards.
Engine Work: SelfDamageEffect - HealEffect with a negative amount would work but reads badly and skips the damage hooks.

Description: Deal 10 damage to everything within 3 tiles of the target.
Deal 20 damage to one target.
Every ally within 2 tiles heals 10.
Summon an elemental that fights for you.
Notes: Check SummonSkeletonWarrior first; this may be mostly authored already.
Engine Work: A summoned character with its own deck and turn. SummonSkeletonWarrior already exists for enemies - this is the player-side version and may be closer than it looks.

Description: Freeze everything within 2 tiles of the target.
Summon a totem that shields nearby allies when they attack.
Notes: Reuses the existing Totem prefab as-is.

Description: Heal everything within 2 tiles of the target for 5.
Deal 25 damage to one target.
Deal 6 damage in a cone and apply 3 Weaken.
Gain 3 Strength, double your next attack, and draw 2.
